For a 2 BHK interior repaint in Hyderabad, these are three purchase-ready options. Current market pricing is roughly ₹25,000–₹70,000 for a standard 2 BHK, depending on paint and wall condition. 
Asian Paints

Provider	Indicative cost	What differentiates it	Important limitation
Asian Paints Beautiful Homes Painting Service	₹25k–₹70k	Branded paint + supervised service; Platinum includes technical evaluation, cleaning and 1-year service/products warranty in Hyderabad. 
Asian Paints
	Final quote requires site assessment; premium finishes cost more
AapkaPainter	Quote required	Large Hyderabad operation; useful if you want a dedicated painting contractor rather than buying directly from a paint brand	Published fixed 2-BHK pricing isn't available; verify preparation/coats and warranty
Deccan Clap	Quote required	Hyderabad-focused local provider; potentially more flexible on labour, paint brand and scope	Get exclusions in writing; don't assume putty/primer/crack repair are included

Before paying: ask all three to quote the same paint grade, putty/primer, number of coats, crack repair, masking, furniture protection, cleanup and warranty.
